---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change to the framework
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

## The problem

What is hard or missing today. One paragraph.

## The proposal

What you would change. Point at files and ADRs where you can.

## What it does not do

State what stays out of scope. Agents propose; humans sign. Proposals that move a decision away from a human need an ADR, so say if this is one.

## Evidence

Tests, a manifest, a conformance run, or a reference. No capability claims without one.

## Roadmap phase

Which phase in ROADMAP.md this belongs to, or "new".
